name: Berbere

recipeInstructions.text: Dry-toast fenugreek seeds, coriander seeds, and cardamom pods in a hot pan for 2 minutes until fragrant. Cool.
Grind toasted seeds to a fine powder.
Combine all spices and salt, mixing well. Adjust chilli heat to preference.
Store in an airtight container for up to 3 months.

description: Ethiopia's essential spice blend — fiery, aromatic, deeply complex. Foundational for doro wat, misir wat, and marinades.
